title: batch refine outcome
description: The outcome of a batch `bl refine` (refine-batch.md), written by the orchestrator to the outcome file from its sub-agents' replies. `bl refine` sets each story's status from its entry (F-68 D3).

summary.description: One line: what the batch planned.

stories.description: One entry per story of the batch. An array, not a map keyed by id: Codex's strict mode refuses an object without fixed properties (S-1408).

refined.description: true: the story is ready for an agent to implement, and bl sets its status to refined. false: bl leaves the status and prints the reason.

reason.description: One line, for every verdict. refined true: why the story is ready for an agent to implement. false: what keeps it from being refined. bl decides from refined alone. It prints reason, and records it as the outcome of the log entry when it sets the status.
